assignments.essential_function: Create consistent competency-based interview questions, panel assignments, scorecards and debrief templates.

review: Selected unchanged as a compact structured-interview workflow. Full source ties consistent behavioral and situational questions to four-to-six role competencies, assigns panel coverage, anchors a one-to-four rubric and produces a debrief template. The skill prepares human interviews; it does not screen resumes, reconcile completed scorecards or make an automated hiring decision.
